**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block unresolved sessions before synchronizing selection**

During a workspace switch, `handleSelectWorkspace` clears `sessionMetaMapAtom` while the previous chat route can remain focused, so `meta` is temporarily undefined and this condition leaves the route as a normal sessions state. The selection effect at lines 564-578 then writes the old session ID back after `App` cleared it, and `AppShell.tsx:1706-1711` independently calls `ensureSessionMessagesLoaded(session.selected)`, issuing `getSessionMessages` for the foreign session and potentially repopulating its atom even though `MainContentPanel` no longer mounts `ChatPage`. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier review thread is this separate AppShell loader; unresolved session details need to remain pending/unavailable until ownership is verified, or selection synchronization must require verified ownership.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
